NHL Scoreboard

Source: R/nhl_scoreboard.R
nhl_scoreboard.Rd

Returns the current league-wide scoreboard with today's games, or — when date is supplied — the scoreboard for a specific date.

Usage

nhl_scoreboard(date = NULL)

Arguments

date

Optional character string in "YYYY-MM-DD" format. When NULL (default) the function hits scoreboard/now; when a date is provided it hits scoreboard/{date}.

Value

A named list of data frames: gamesByDate.

gamesByDate

col_nametypesdescription
datecharacterDate for which the games are listed.
gameslistNested list of games scheduled on the date.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(nhl_scoreboard())
#> $focusedDate
#> [1] "2026-10-08"
#> 
#> $focusedDateCount
#> [1] 11
#> 
#> $gamesByDate
#>          date
#> 1  2026-10-05
#> 2  2026-10-06
#> 3  2026-10-07
#> 4  2026-10-08
#> 5  2026-10-09
#> 6  2026-10-10
#> 7  2026-10-11
#> 8  2026-10-12
#> 9  2026-10-13
#> 10 2026-10-14
#> 11 2026-10-15
#>
